finds.quote: Whether repeated context-window loading approximates fine-tuning over time is the central open question. The TLL hypothesis predicts yes: documents that enter the training layer through indexing and crawling convert temporary inference-time effects into permanent weight-level effects. The Qiu et al. paper provides the theoretical framework for testing this prediction, but the test itself remains to be conducted.
